summary: Architecture/design evidence for true semantic (embedding-based) Bible search - the harder 'conceptual references' tier the Phase 4 gap audit and Phase 4.1 both explicitly left as a documented, not-yet-started gap (no shared vocabulary with the target verse, so lexical/keyword overlap cannot find it).

constraintDrivingTheArchitecture.operatorInstruction: "Remember CIP should run not on an api that needs subscription every month but on a free model." - stated explicitly by the operator after sharing competitor (Pewbeam) analysis recommending cloud APIs (Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Gemini Live, GPT-4o-mini, Groq).
constraintDrivingTheArchitecture.consequence: Every embedding option evaluated was local-only from the start; no cloud embedding API (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage) was ever considered, mirroring Phase 4.3's own free-local-model constraint for speech.

backendSelection.candidatesConsidered: candle (HuggingFace's pure-Rust ML framework) vs. ONNX Runtime (the `ort` crate, a heavy C++ binary dependency).
backendSelection.decidingEvidence: A real, disposable smoke-compile test (not reasoning alone) confirmed candle/tokenizers cross-compile cleanly to x86_64-pc-windows-gnu with zero CMake/C++ build step of its own - unlike whisper-rs-sys's real, multi-fix saga (ggml lib-naming, mingw threading model) documented in docs/phase-3-8-6-windows-whisper-build.md. This directly informed choosing candle over ONNX Runtime, which would likely have reproduced a similar cross-compile fight.
backendSelection.confirmedAgainInThisPhasesRealBuild: scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh's Windows rebuild for this phase needed zero new fixes for candle - only the pre-existing whisper.cpp fixes were still required, confirming the smoke test's finding held for the real production build too.

modelSelection.chosenModel: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim, mean-pooling + L2-normalize per its own model card recipe)
modelSelection.whyThisModel: candle-transformers' own bert.rs source has this exact model's architecture hyperparameters hardcoded (in a private `_all_mini_lm_l6_v2()` constructor) - confirmed by direct source inspection. Reproducing those same published values (vocab_size 30522, hidden_size 384, 6 layers, 12 heads, intermediate_size 1536, GELU activation) as a public config in ai/embeddings/src/candle_engine.rs means the operator only needs to supply two files (model.safetensors + tokenizer.json), never a third config.json - simplifying provisioning to mirror WHISPER_MODEL_FILENAME's own single-file precedent as closely as the model architecture allows.
modelSelection.userConfirmation: User's explicit instruction: "Yes, proceed with all-MiniLM-L6-v2" after being shown this reasoning.

storageDesign.modelIdKeying: bible_verse_embeddings' primary key is (verse_id, model_id), not verse_id alone - migration 0013's own comments explain why: switching, upgrading, or misconfiguring the embedding model must never silently mix vectors from two different models into one cosine-similarity comparison. Old rows for a since-abandoned model_id simply stop being selected by best_semantic_match's WHERE clause, never deleted - no destructive migration needed on a model change.
storageDesign.dimensionsRedundancy: dimensions is stored alongside the vector itself (not only implied by model_id) so is_valid_embedding can reject a mismatched-dimension read with one integer comparison, never a partial dot-product against a corrupt/truncated row.
storageDesign.encodingChoice: Raw little-endian f32 BLOB (4 * dimensions bytes) - cheapest possible encoding for values only ever read back into a Vec<f32> in-process, never queried by SQL itself. Verified via a direct round-trip unit test (the_store_returns_generated_embeddings_round_tripped_correctly, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/embeddings.rs).

concurrencyDesign.problemFound: rusqlite::Connection is not Sync (RefCell-based statement cache/inner connection), but cip_core_bible::VerseEmbeddingStore requires Send + Sync (a trait-object bound the live pipeline needs). An initial design wrapping a borrowed &Connection failed to compile with a direct, unambiguous rustc error (E0277) during this phase's own verification pass - caught before it ever reached a real build, not discovered via a runtime deadlock.
concurrencyDesign.fix: SqliteVerseEmbeddingStore now owns a dedicated Mutex<Connection> (mirroring SqliteBibleProvider's own exact shape, and AppState's established 'every independent read path gets its own connection' discipline - see music_provider/acoustic_music_engine's own precedent) rather than borrowing the live pipeline's already-locked AppState.db connection. This also means a long-running generate_verse_embeddings call (which can take minutes for a full translation) never contends with the live pipeline's own database access - they use physically separate connections into the same on-disk SQLite file.
concurrencyDesign.generationLockGranularity: generate_verse_embeddings_for_translation holds its connection's lock only briefly per verse (once to read the pending list, once per verse to write its row) rather than for the whole run - the expensive part (engine.embed(), one CPU-bound forward pass per verse) always runs with the lock released.

detectionPipelineDesign.fallbackOrdering: try_semantic is attempted only after both an explicit citation AND the lexical paraphrase fallback (Phase 4.1) have already failed to produce a suggestion - never second-guesses either, mirroring try_paraphrase's own established never-override rule exactly.
detectionPipelineDesign.neverMutatesContext: Verified by a dedicated unit test (semantic_detection_never_mutates_the_active_context) - a semantic match is not a citation, so it must never establish or replace the active Scripture context the way a real Chapter/Direct reference does.
detectionPipelineDesign.revalidatesAgainstRealData: best_semantic_match's winning reference is re-validated via provider.get_verse() before becoming a suggestion - a stored embedding pointing at a reference the current Bible dataset doesn't actually have (e.g. after a translation re-import changes verse ids) produces no suggestion at all, verified by a_semantic_match_for_a_reference_absent_from_the_provider_is_never_suggested.
detectionPipelineDesign.confidenceThreshold: MIN_SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY = 0.55, documented as chosen conservatively (published all-MiniLM-L6-v2 benchmarks put closely related sentence pairs in the 0.6-0.9 range, unrelated pairs below 0.3) rather than empirically calibrated - no real model inference was available to tune this against a labeled dataset in this network-restricted container. Revisit once real operator feedback on live services is available - stated honestly in the code comment itself (core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs), not hidden.

testCoverage.coreServiceNewTests: 5 new tests in core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs covering: a conceptual paraphrase with no lexical overlap producing a semantic suggestion; the plain (non-semantic) entry point never attempting the fallback; an explicit citation never second-guessed; context never mutated; a semantic match for an absent reference never suggested.
testCoverage.coreBibleSemanticTests: 6 new tests in core/bible/src/semantic.rs for best_semantic_match: highest-scoring match returned above threshold, none returned below threshold, a different model's embeddings ignored, mismatched-dimension rows ignored, empty store returns none.
testCoverage.aiEmbeddingsTests: 9 tests total (2 in core/ai's EmbeddingEngine trait tests, 7 in ai/embeddings/src/pooling.rs for mean_pool/l2_normalize edge cases: masked positions, single token, all-masked, empty input, mismatched lengths, unit-vector normalization, zero-vector normalization).
testCoverage.desktopEmbeddingsModuleTests: 7 tests in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/embeddings.rs: full-translation generation, idempotent re-run, per-model-id independence, round-trip storage, unconfigured-model-id isolation, coverage counting for both a configured and unconfigured model.
testCoverage.databaseMigrationTests: 2 new tests in database/src/migrations.rs: table/index existence, duplicate (verse_id, model_id) pair rejected by the primary key.
testCoverage.configTests: 2 new tests in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/config.rs mirroring the existing Whisper model-path tests exactly: default path resolution, CIP_EMBEDDING_MODEL_PATH/CIP_EMBEDDING_TOKENIZER_PATH env overrides.

regressionResult: cargo fmt --check clean. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean under BOTH default features and --features whisper,semantic-search together. cargo test --workspace: every crate green under both feature configurations (53 test binaries, zero failures). cip-desktop alone: 289 passed (up from 280 at the Phase 4.3 baseline).
